map.基于 Cochran 公式计算调查所需最小样本量，支持有限总体修正（FPC），并: Computes the minimum sample size needed for a survey with the Cochran formula, supports finite population correction (FPC) and compares requirements across confidence levels.
map.📖 查看「最小样本量估算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Minimum Sample Size Estimator User Guide"
map.Cochran 公式 n₀=z²·p(1−p)/e²（z 为置信水平对应分位数，: Cochran formula n₀ = z²·p(1−p)/e² (z is the quantile for the chosen confidence level and e the margin of error); finite population correction n = n₀/(1+(n₀−1)/N). The expected proportion p = 0.5 gives the largest sample size; use a smaller value when a truer proportion is known.
map.预期比例 p（%，最大方差取50）: Expected proportion p (%, use 50 for maximum variance)
map.总体规模 N（选填，<10万时启用FPC）: Population size N (optional, FPC applies below 100000)
map.💡 Cochran 公式：n₀ = Z²·p·(1−p) ÷ e²；有限总体修正: 💡 Cochran Formula: n₀ = Z²·p·(1−p) / e²; finite population correction n = n₀ / (1 + (n₀−1)/N).
map.p=50% 时方差最大，样本量最保守，适用于未知总体特征时: p = 50% gives maximum variance and the most conservative sample size, used when population characteristics are unknown
map.总体规模 N=0 或留空表示视为无限总体，不启用 FPC: A population size N of 0 or blank means an infinite population, so no FPC is applied
map.实际回收需考虑应答率，按公式结果 ÷ 应答率放大: Actual collection must allow for response rate: inflate the formula result by dividing by the response rate
map.分层抽样请在分层配额工具中按层分配: For stratified sampling, allocate by stratum in the stratified quota tool
map.做问卷/投放 A/B 前先算需要多少样本才 statistically 可靠。: Before a survey or an A/B test, compute how many samples make the result statistically reliable
map.已知置信水平与误差限度，反推最小: With the confidence level and margin of error known, work back the minimum
map.比例未知时取 p=0.5 得最保守（最大）样本量。: When the proportion is unknown, take p = 0.5 for the most conservative (largest) sample size.
map.n=(z²·p·(1−p))/e²，z=1.96、p=0.5、e=0.05 →: n = (z²·p·(1−p))/e² with z = 1.96, p = 0.5 and e = 0.05 gives n = 1.96²×0.25/0.0025 ≈ 384.16, rounded up to 385 responses. This is the most conservative sample size.
map.同样 p=0.5、e=5%：90% 置信 z=1.645 → n≈267；95%: With p = 0.5 and e = 5%: 90% confidence gives z = 1.645 and n ≈ 267; 95% gives 385; 99% gives z = 2.576 and 663. Higher confidence or smaller error means more samples.
map.p(1−p) 在 p=0.5 时最大，算出的样本量最保守，确保即使真实比例未知也: p(1−p) is maximized at p = 0.5, which gives the most conservative sample size and ensures enough samples even when the true proportion is unknown.
map.误差限度 e 怎么定？: How is the margin of error e set?
map.按决策精度需求，市场调研常用 ±3%–5%；误差减半样本量翻 4 倍，需权衡成本: Set it by the precision the decision needs; market research commonly uses ±3%-5%. Halving the error quadruples the sample size, so weigh the cost.
map.调查最小样本量估算工具，基于 Cochran 公式与有限总体修正（FPC），支持: Survey minimum sample size estimator: based on the Cochran formula and finite population correction (FPC), supports 90/95/99/99.5% confidence levels, compares sample requirements across confidence levels and inflates for response rate.
